reading: This is a file-drive page: a left sidebar with a 'Drive' header, nav links, and a storage usage bar; a breadcrumb trail above a toolbar with New folder/Sort buttons and an Upload button; a grid of 8 file/folder tiles below; and a right-hand detail panel listing metadata for the selected file.
